title: Foundry adopter project inventory (.claude/foundry-project.json)
description: The WHAT of an adopter's project: the repo/package inventory generic foundry primitives resolve project-specifics from instead of hardcoding them. Deliberately PERMISSIVE -- this file is inherently project-specific (names, repo paths, boot commands) and adopters extend it freely, so the schema pins the structural spine and the shape of the blocks consumers actually read, not an exhaustive closed vocabulary.

repos.description: Map of repo key -> repo record. Consumers resolve paths and boot recipes from here.

path.description: On-disk location of this repo, relative to the workspace root (or absolute). Required -- a record with no path validates against nothing and fails at dispatch. Must not begin with '-' (an argv-hostile shape).

remote.description: Optional clone provenance: the URL (https://, ssh://, git://, or scp-like [user@]host:path) or local path this repo was/should be cloned from. Not validated for URL semantics -- only shape (non-empty, no leading '-', no C0/C1 control characters, since the value reaches an argv position and a terminal).

default_branch.description: Optional standing-ref branch name this repo tracks (distinct from a point-in-time pin, which lives in each atom's .foundry/build-provenance.yaml). Same shape floor as remote: no leading '-', no C0/C1 control characters.

role.description: Closed governance vocabulary for this repo's place in the control plane: 'product' -- the repo that ships the product; 'handbook' -- the agentic-handbook template/methodology repo; 'infra' -- infrastructure/provisioning code; 'app' -- a runnable application/service surface (product and app overlap for a single-app product; the distinction is descriptive); 'workspace' -- the self-entry a freshly seeded manifest may carry for the workspace root itself. Free-form prose belongs in the sibling `description` field, not here.

description.description: Optional free-form prose about this repo record -- the home for anything that used to be written into `role` before `role` closed to its governance vocabulary.

gates.description: Adopter-tunable gate knobs, merged over each consumer's shipped defaults.
